source_item: WebSocketRoute root-path match, Router miss, and standalone HTTP-scope dispatch
stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocketRoute(/rooms/{room:str}) and an application; dispatch a root_path-prefixed matching WebSocket scope, an unmatched WebSocket scope, and a matching HTTP scope directly to the standalone route.

source_item: Router built-in converter matching and ordered route selection
stimulus_summary: Dispatch built-in str, int, float, uuid, and path converters; exercise invalid converter paths, static/parameter declaration orders, identical path registrations with method fallthrough, root_path matching and prefix boundaries, and a Python-registered override of str.

source_item: Request path_params with built-in converters and CPython integer digit limit
stimulus_summary: Run Request-style endpoint observations for str, int, float, uuid, and path values plus a 5001-digit int parameter against CPython 3.12's default conversion limit.

source_item: Mount nested paths, scope composition, and inner misses
stimulus_summary: Exercise flat and recursively nested Mounts with typed path parameters, scope overrides, accumulated root_path, retained app_root_path, successful leaf responses, outer and inner misses, and child 404/405 outcomes.
